Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

descriptions.medium: A heist like no other! A motley crew of misfits hunts down an infamous 80's arcade game that can supposedly control people's minds in this chart-topping feel-good British comedy.
A nine-year-old brings a warrior from the future to the present and an evil follows. An amazingly cool and funny Sci-fi comedy with kids cursing, lasers, time travel, aliens, martial arts, and more!

Shaina lives 600 years in the future. She's read about poverty, oppression, and violence in history books. When she accidentally time travels to our times, she assumes that everyone is caring and honest as she tries to recruit help to get back home.

descriptions.tiny: Child monks battle against ninjas.
descriptions.small: Child monks battle against ninjas to save their temple and protect a Ching prince.
descriptions.large: A Royal prince is hiding out in the Shaolin Temple. The evil Empress employs a band of ruthless Manchu fighters and Japanese Ninjas to try to force the prince to come out of the temple. But the little mighty monks of Shaolin prove too powerful for them. The prince is safe and will soon become the Emperor of China.

XM0KLMU1QVUTHM.title: Thundering Mantis aka Mantis Fist Fighter

descriptions.tiny: A martial arts student is expelled from his school.
descriptions.small: A martial arts student is expelled from his school after a fight with one of Boss Hsia's men.
descriptions.large: Ah Chi (Ka-Yan Leung) is obsessed with the martial arts, and more often than not, his kung-fu clowning gets him into trouble. Ending up facing Hsia (Eddie Ko) of the notorious Jade Brotherhood is inevitable. As a result, Hsia forces Chi's martial arts master to expel him. Master less and working for a fish vendor, Chi meets a crafty kid (Wong Yat Lung), who's Uncle Chow Tung (Yuet Sang Chin) is a master of the insane Mantis style.

descriptions.tiny: Kung-fu hero recovers crown jewel in Hong Kong.
descriptions.large: This is the tale of a vengeful Interpol agent and master of the Eagle Claw kung fu named Tiger (Bruce Li) whose brother was killed mercilessly. Tiger now turns up with a lady cop named Sergeant Li (Christina Chung) and together they become a nightmare for the thugs and smugglers of Hong Kong.

descriptions.tiny: Itto is in the middle of a war between two Yakuza families.
descriptions.small: A scheming magistrate's plan places Itto in the middle of a war between two Yakuza families.
descriptions.large: During the time when christianity was punishable by death in Japan, Lord Retsudou threatens to persecute a clan leader's wife, who is secretly a Christian. The clan leader, who is a former disciple of the lone wolf, has no choice but to fight his old master.

The story revolves around a man attempting to escape his criminal past only to be drawn into an organized crime war over a stolen diamond. Enter a Caucasian insurance investigator in Hong Kong hired to apparently track down the same diamond which the ninja is also interested in.

descriptions.small: A group of archaeologists awakens an ancient evil that was created by the SS during WWII.
descriptions.medium: While cataloguing World War 2 relics in a newly declassified British military site, a group of archaeologists unleash an ancient evil.
descriptions.large: Jasper is asked by his famous archaeologist father to catalogue World War 2 relics at a newly declassified Fort in England. With the help of 3 archaeologists they discover a hidden room that holds a mysterious box, but when that box is opened... they awaken an ancient evil. Now they must use their wits and knowledge to survive the night!

descriptions.medium: What begins as a carefree bachelorette trip becomes a nightmare when a starving tiger locks onto the women as its next prey, forcing them into a brutal battle to survive.

descriptions.small: A new victim has been chosen to face off against a ravenous shark in a Texas lake.

descriptions.tiny: Soldiers battle an army of dinosaurs in a remote jungle.
descriptions.small: After surviving a crash landing, soldiers must battle an army of dinosaurs in a remote jungle.
descriptions.medium: A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long-hidden dinosaurs.

descriptions.tiny: An ambitious reporter and a prince fall for each other.
descriptions.small: An ambitious reporter and an impetuous prince cross paths and begin to fall for each other.
descriptions.medium: In search of her big break, a reporter (brittany underwood) arranges a christmas interview with a european.

descriptions.tiny: A model spends the week before Christmas with her chauffeur.
descriptions.small: A winter storm forces a fashion model to spend the week before Christmas with her chauffeur.
descriptions.medium: While on a charity press tour, a model (ash tsai) ends up stranded by the weather at the family home of the.

descriptions.tiny: Caterer Molly is hired for the Harrison Foundation's gala.

descriptions.medium: A fledgling caterer, Mandy Frost, is hired by Jean Kimberly, the perfectionistic director of the renowned
descriptions.large: Fledgling caterer Molly Frost is hired by perfectionist Jean Harrison for the renowned Harrison Foundation's annual Christmas Gala, but things get complicated when she falls for Jean's nephew, a photographer with no desire to take over the foundation. Molly shows Carson all the good his family is able to provide.

descriptions.tiny: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow.
descriptions.small: Everyone's getting ready for Christmas in Icicle Falls, especially on Candy Cane Lane, where holiday
descriptions.medium: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

descriptions.tiny: The undead patrolman avenges a wounded police officer.
descriptions.small: Zombie cop Officer Matt Cordell's third ride from beyond the grave has him looking for a girlfriend.
descriptions.medium: Zombie cop Officer Matt Cordell's (Robert Z'Dar, "Tango & Cash") third ride from beyond the grave has him looking for a girlfriend - someone nice, tender and undead.
descriptions.large: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

descriptions.tiny: A couple's newborn turns out to be a lizard-like creature.
descriptions.small: Henry Spencer tries to survive his environment, his girlfriend, and the screams of his child.
descriptions.medium: Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant child.
descriptions.large: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

descriptions.tiny: Teens trapped in mall with wacko security robots.
descriptions.small: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall.
descriptions.medium: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

descriptions.tiny: Deadly wasps threaten a small town.
descriptions.small: The residents of a small town battle a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.
descriptions.medium: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

descriptions.tiny: Cultists offer human hands to their god.
descriptions.small: A family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.
descriptions.medium: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

descriptions.tiny: Nate goes on a mission to find a wife.
descriptions.small: When Nate's livelihood becomes dependent on his marital status, he goes on a mission to find a wife.
descriptions.medium: When Nate's livelihood becomes dependent on his marital status, he makes it his mission to find a wife in a city where most are single.
descriptions.large: Nate is a part-time Uber drive and a music video director, and is becoming a rising star in the music and video world. Everything is going great, except for the fact that he doesn't have citizenship. He knows the easiest way for him to get citizenship is to get married, but he won't settle for just any woman. Will he run out of time before immigration is onto him?

descriptions.tiny: James is looking to get a piece of his lottery winnings.
descriptions.small: Now enemies, James and Darnell find themselves fighting the battle to stay alive.
descriptions.medium: James is out of jail, and is looking for Darnell to get a piece of his lotto winnings, but Darnell feels differently. Now enemies they both find themselves fighting the battle to stay alive, but the death of a close friend changes everything.

descriptions.tiny: An affair turns fatal after a woman confronts her boyfriend.
descriptions.small: An affair turns fatal after a woman confronts her cheating boyfriend.
descriptions.medium: Events over the course of one traumatic night in Georgia unfold as the reckless Kennedy discovers her lovers darkest secrets.

descriptions.small: Naomi meets a handsome, older man who seems too good to be true.
descriptions.medium: Naomi Anderson is a college student, struggling financially looking for a new job. She meets a successful, handsome, older gentleman that gives her everything she's been dreaming of. Naomi soon realizes her dreams may come at aprice.

descriptions.tiny: Nightmarish visions draw teenagers to a deserted prison.
descriptions.small: A student (Nicholas Celozzi) and a singer (Toni Basil) exorcize a cannibal on Alcatraz.

descriptions.tiny: A young woman is in danger of becoming a werewolf.
descriptions.small: A young woman (Emily Perkins) is in danger of becoming a werewolf.
descriptions.medium: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

descriptions.tiny: Sisters encounter werewolves in 19th-century Canada.
descriptions.small: Sisters (Katharine Isabelle, Emily Perkins) encounter werewolves in 19th-century Canada.
descriptions.medium: Sisters (Katharine Isabelle, Emily Perkins) in 19th-century Canada take refuge at a remote outpost that is besieged by werewolves.
descriptions.large: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

MV002284630000.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior

descriptions.tiny: A man seeks vengeance against a king who kills his father.
descriptions.small: A young man (Michael Copon) seeks vengeance against a king (Randy Couture) who kills his father.
descriptions.medium: To avenge his father's death, a young man (Michael Copon) embarks on a quest against a king (Randy Couture).
descriptions.large: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

MV006624510000.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power

descriptions.tiny: Mathayus and his allies have to stop an evil heir.
descriptions.small: Mathayus and his allies have to stop an evil heir from finding a mythical power.
descriptions.medium: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

descriptions.tiny: Scientist Bruce Banner transforms into a powerful brute.
descriptions.small: Scientist Bruce Banner (Eric Bana) transforms into a powerful brute after his experiment goes awry.
descriptions.medium: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.
descriptions.large: Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

descriptions.tiny: A young police officer tries to crack a Hong Kong syndicate.
descriptions.small: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves.
descriptions.medium: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

descriptions.tiny: Woman (Bridget Fonda) has incriminating film of politician.
descriptions.small: A politician sends an agent after his ex-fiancee, who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.
descriptions.medium: A sleazy politician sends an agent (Russell Crowe) after his ex-fiancee (Bridget Fonda), who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.
descriptions.large: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

descriptions.tiny: Actors portray varieties of a type: the new bohemian.
descriptions.small: Richard Linklater uses mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.
descriptions.medium: Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.
descriptions.large: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

descriptions.tiny: Werner Herzog's remake of the 1922 vampire classic.
descriptions.small: Dracula (Klaus Kinski) is bald, pale, tired and cursed with immortality.
descriptions.medium: Bald, pale, tired and cursed with immortality, Count Dracula (Klaus Kinski) visits a plague of rats upon Europe.
descriptions.large: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

descriptions.small: Ashley accepts a job helping others but can't tell anyone that her boss is a Secret Santa.
descriptions.large: Ashley feels alone this Christmas as she searches fruitlessly for a job to support herself and her dog, Dash. But her neighbor Nick knows exactly what to do. He offers her a job as his assistant in the best work of all----helping others. There's only one catch: Ashley can't tell anyone that her boss is a sort of Secret Santa. When a nosy reporter, Will, takes interest in Ashley, she struggles to keep Nick's secret while protecting her heart.

descriptions.medium: Eliza is reunited with Will, a former heartthrob, who helps her rediscover the significance of Christmas.
descriptions.large: Eliza, a writer for travel magazines and websites, has returned to her small hometown after an absence. Despite the passage of time, not much has changed in the town, and her family continues to participate in the same traditions. Through these activities, Eliza is reunited with Will, a former heartthrob, who helps her rediscover the significance of these family traditions.

descriptions.medium: When unlucky-in-love Isabella and filmmaker Blake find themselves planning a huge celebration in a mansion, neither knew what they'd find. They unexpectedly find a love and adventure they never knew could be true.
In pursuit of Civil War gold to save their ranch, two kids help an old woman solve the mystery of her past.

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!
A gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles.

descriptions.small: A college boy finds his hometown is not so normal when he discovers a human ear in a field.
Friends have 24 hours to stop a package, prevent disaster and fall in love.

descriptions.tiny: Alien bounty hunters disrupt a warrior's vacation on Earth.
descriptions.small: Galactic rogue Shep Ramsey goes from deep space to the American suburbs.
descriptions.medium: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).
descriptions.large: Problems with his rocket compel space-traveling vigilante Shep Ramsey (Hulk Hogan) to spend some time on Earth. Plunking himself down in the middle of suburbia, he rents a room from Charlie (Christopher Lloyd) and Jenny Wilcox (Shelley Duvall). Shep attempts to acclimate himself -- he skateboards, he accosts a mail carrier -- but he's destined to be a fish out of water. But when his outer space enemies arrive and pick a fight with his new friends, Shep is ready to prove his mettle.

descriptions.small: Two jilted lovers meet while spying on their respective exes.

descriptions.tiny: Two strangers spend an unforgettable day together in Vienna.
Murder linked to buried treasure.
descriptions.small: Jessica helps the sheriff of an old Western town solve a murder.
descriptions.medium: In New Mexico, Jessica links the murder of the owner of an Old West tourist attraction to buried treasure.

EP000029950195.title: Sugar and Spice, Malice and Vice

descriptions.tiny: Michael is suspected of murder.
descriptions.small: Jessica must clear Michael Hagarty of killing his future son-in-law.
descriptions.medium: Michael Hagarty (Len Cariou) is suspected of murdering his future son-in-law, thought to be involved in an illegal banking scheme.

descriptions.tiny: Man disappears with $150 million.
descriptions.small: The father (Wayne Tippett) of Jessica's editor (Jessica Tuck) disappears with $150 million.
descriptions.medium: Jessica investigates the mysterious disappearance of her editor's millionaire father along with $150 million from his corporate account.

descriptions.tiny: Future son-in-law is shooting suspect.
descriptions.small: Jessica investigates a shooting at the Cabot Cove Christmas celebration.
descriptions.medium: The future son-in-law (Sean O'Bryan) of a prominent Cabot Cove family is suspected in the shooting of a hardware store employee.

descriptions.tiny: A record executive is murdered.
descriptions.small: The owner of a record company producing Jessica's book on tape is murdered; guest Richard Beymer.
descriptions.medium: Jessica uses her knowledge of music to investigate the murder of the owner of the record company that is producing one of her mysteries on tape.

descriptions.tiny: A retired actor is suspected of murder.
descriptions.small: Seth's actor friend confronts ghosts from his past and a murder.
descriptions.medium: Seth's friend (Peter Donat), an actor coming out of retirement to launch a play, is implicated in the murder of his ex-manager (Bradford Dillman).

descriptions.tiny: A killer frames Jessica's student.
descriptions.small: A murderer uses information from Jessica's writing class to kill a mob boss and frame a student.
descriptions.medium: One of Jessica's students is framed for murder when someone uses information from her creative writing class to kill a local crime boss.

descriptions.large: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

descriptions.tiny: Strange events at Fort Henry.
descriptions.small: Employees and visitors witness strange and frightening events at Fort Henry.
descriptions.medium: Employees and visitors witness strange and frightening events at Fort Henry, a former prisoner-of-war camp during World War II.
descriptions.large: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

descriptions.tiny: The team investigates Briarhurst Manor.
descriptions.small: The team travels to Colorado to investigate paranormal activity at Briarhurst Manor.
descriptions.large: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

descriptions.tiny: The grave of Buffalo Bill.
descriptions.small: Actor Eddie McClintock joins the TAPS team for an investigation of the grave of Buffalo Bill.
descriptions.medium: Actor Eddie McClintock joins the TAPS team for an investigation of the grave of Buffalo Bill; the team investigates Oakland Hall in Eaton, Ga.
descriptions.large: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

descriptions.tiny: TAPS investigates the Amos Blake House.
descriptions.small: TAPS investigates the historical Amos Blake House in Fitzwilliam, N.H.; the team travels to Florida.
descriptions.medium: TAPS investigates the historical Amos Blake House in Fitzwilliam, N.H.; the team travels to Florida to investigate a historical museum.
descriptions.large: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

descriptions.tiny: The TAPS crew investigates a lighthouse.
descriptions.small: The TAPS crew investigates paranormal activity at a lighthouse in Pensacola, Fla.
descriptions.large: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

descriptions.tiny: A menagerie is featured in the Bible.
descriptions.large: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

descriptions.tiny: The home to hundreds of black bears.
descriptions.small: Anchorage, Alaska, is home to hundreds of black bears; these black bears are patrolling the city.
descriptions.medium: Anchorage, Alaska, is home to hundreds of black bears; it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city; with their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in the urban jungle.
descriptions.large: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

descriptions.small: Tropical forests of Costa Rica are an invaluable habitat for a series of rare species.
descriptions.medium: The tropical forests of Costa Rica constitute an invaluable habitat for a series of common species. We travel the "Green Corridors", from the Corcovado National Park to the Caribbean coast, in search of these species.
descriptions.large: The tropical rainforests of Costa Rica provide an invaluable habitat to several emblematic species, such as jaguars, tapirs, white-lipped peccaries, spider monkeys, the very rear green macaw, amongst many others. Most of them are protected in national parks, reserves and wildlife refuges. However, the long-term survival of these ecosystems and of their biodiversity rely on the success of connecting wildlife populations throughout the country.

descriptions.tiny: Herds of animals migrate.
descriptions.small: Herds of animals on the move migrate across the planet in a great natural phenomenon.
descriptions.medium: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

descriptions.tiny: The factors determining life expectancy.
descriptions.small: Experts take a look into the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy.
descriptions.medium: Experts take a look into the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animals.
descriptions.large: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

descriptions.tiny: The planet's defining environment.
descriptions.small: Covering over seventy percent of the globe, oceans are our planet's defining environment.
descriptions.medium: Covering over seventy percent of the globe, oceans are our planet's defining environment; yet this underwater world remains one of mystery.
descriptions.large: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

descriptions.tiny: Wetlands are diverse ecosystems.
descriptions.small: Wetlands are among the most productive and biologically diverse ecosystems on the planet.
descriptions.medium: Wetlands are among the most productive and biologically diverse ecosystems on the planet; these aquatic landscapes can be found around the world.
descriptions.large: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

descriptions.tiny: Deserts are far from lifeless.
descriptions.small: While hostile to life, deserts are far from lifeless and offer surprising diversity.
descriptions.medium: While hostile to life, deserts are far from lifeless and offer surprising diversity in the animals that inhabit them.
descriptions.large: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

descriptions.tiny: Bird species face an uncertain future.
descriptions.small: With pollution above and habitat degradation below, bird species face an uncertain future.
descriptions.medium: With pollution above and habitat degradation below, bird species face an uncertain future; explore the lives of pelicans, barn owls and vultures.
descriptions.large: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

descriptions.tiny: Contestants get a chance to win money.
descriptions.small: Contestants get a chance to win money, from one penny to $1 million.

descriptions.tiny: Contestants get a chance to win money.

descriptions.medium: A conservative minister is murdered while trying to close down a traveling bordello operating near his church.
After an employee of the high school is run off the road by the driver of a semi-truck, resulting in death.

Chief Gillespie has a suspect in mind for a murder, but it happens to be the most powerful man in town.
Harriet is determined to bring her sister's killer to justice and decides to try handling things on her own.

In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is neververy close.

When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his wordeven the Air Forceand soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But waitdid he even want to?

Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

XT0GE81XDFATOY.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

descriptions.medium: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

descriptions.tiny: Thieves plan to rob a relay station in Apache country.
descriptions.small: Cowboy (Rory Calhoun) thwarts businessman, gold thief (John Russell).
descriptions.medium: A cowboy (Rory Calhoun) thwarts a businessman and a thief (John Russell) out to rob gold from a stage station.

descriptions.medium: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

descriptions.tiny: Una joven conoce a un ex convicto que la hace estrella.
descriptions.medium: Una joven mesera conoce a un ex productor de cine que acaba de salir de prisión y la hace estrella de cine.

descriptions.tiny: Coming to the rescue.
descriptions.small: An adventurer (Bill Paxton) and his family battle a criminal.
descriptions.medium: An adventurer (Bill Paxton) and his family battle a criminal mastermind after he attacks their base and plans to rob the world's largest banks.
descriptions.large: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

descriptions.tiny: You think you know who you are. You have no idea.
descriptions.small: Racial tensions collide in a collection of intertwined stories involving residents of Los Angeles.
descriptions.large: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

descriptions.tiny: Dakota scout (Van Heflin) objects to cavalry methods.
descriptions.small: A Dakota scout disagrees with a cavalry lieutenant about the best way to avoid a massacre.
descriptions.medium: A Dakota scout (Van Heflin) disagrees with a cavalry lieutenant (Alex Nicol) about the best way to avoid a massacre.

descriptions.tiny: A man dumps his lover's corpse in an already occupied grave.
descriptions.small: A man (Andrew Scott) dumps his lover's corpse in an already occupied grave.
descriptions.medium: Events spin out of control after a young man (Andrew Scott) deposits his lover's corpse in a shallow grave that is already occupied.
descriptions.large: The reappearance of his ex-girlfriend Jean (Katy Davis) threatens to put a damper on Tommy's (Andrew Scott) happy bachelorhood -- but he gets far more than he bargained for when he returns to his apartment to find her dead body. Fearful of becoming a murder suspect, Tommy hatches a plan with pal Noel (Darren Healy) to dispose of the body. But his perfect plan unravels when police dogs track down two corpses in the same place: Jean's, and that of a prominent politician's wife.

descriptions.tiny: Una joven oculta la infidelidad de la esposa de su jefe.
descriptions.small: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y ella no la delata.
descriptions.medium: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y para ayudar dice que es suyo, pero el patrón descubre todo.

descriptions.tiny: Nobody believes a liar ... even when he's telling the truth.
descriptions.small: Murders occur when teens (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) invent a story about a killer.
descriptions.medium: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

descriptions.tiny: How did a crime with this many witnesses go so far?
descriptions.small: A teenage drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) kidnaps the younger brother of a debt-ridden junkie.
descriptions.medium: A teenage dealer (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother of a junkie who won't pay for the drugs.
descriptions.large: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

descriptions.tiny: Una maestra acompaña a sus alumnas a un paseo al campo.
descriptions.small: Una maestra pasa unas vacaciones de verano con sus alumnas y sus padres en un rancho.
descriptions.medium: Una maestra es invitada por los padres de algunas de sus alumnas a pasar las vacaciones de verano en un rancho.

descriptions.tiny: Four martial artists unite against a sinister force.
descriptions.small: The world's deadliest assassins will enter. Only the best will survive.
descriptions.medium: Four rivals (Devon Aoki, Jaime Pressly, Sarah Carter, Holly Valance) at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat.
descriptions.large: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

descriptions.tiny: Hit men converge on Lake Tahoe to rub out a mob informant.
descriptions.small: Two FBI agents must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) who has agreed to testify against the mob.
descriptions.medium: Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) must protect an entertainer (Jeremy Piven) from a motley crew of assassins after the guy agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob.
descriptions.large: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

descriptions.tiny: A cunning serial killer victimizes two traveling students.
descriptions.small: A killer (Sean Bean) terrorizes two students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) who give him a ride.
descriptions.medium: Two traveling students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) pick up a hitchhiker (Sean Bean), unaware that he is a serial killer who intends to pin his crimes on them.
descriptions.large: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

descriptions.tiny: A madman tries to restore his daughter's mutilated face.
descriptions.small: A surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with stolen skin.
descriptions.medium: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.
descriptions.large: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

descriptions.tiny: A policewoman seeks the source of a batch of cocaine.
descriptions.small: Drug dealer wants bodyguard (Sam Elliott) to stop L.A. policewoman (Whoopi Goldberg).
descriptions.medium: A big-time drug dealer sends his bodyguard (Sam Elliott) to stop a Los Angeles policewoman (Whoopi Goldberg) who's bad for business.
descriptions.large: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

descriptions.tiny: The owner of a bait shop competes in a fishing tournament.
descriptions.small: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a bait shop competes in a fishing tournament.
descriptions.medium: The owner (Bill Engvall) of a small-town bait shop competes in a fishing tournament for the prize money to save his business.

descriptions.tiny: FBI agents investigate the rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.small: FBI agents (Julia Ormond, Bill Pullman) investigate the bloody rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.medium: FBI agents (Julia Ormond, Bill Pullman) interrogate witnesses who survive the bloody rampage of two serial killers.
descriptions.large: After a spree of horrific murders in the New Mexico desert, two FBI agents arrive at a small Santa Fe police station to interview the key witnesses. Using elaborate surveillance equipment to view the interrogations simultaneously, Sam Hallaway watches as his partner cross-examines the three survivors. As several inconsistencies emerge, it becomes clear that somebody in the room knows the truth behind the slayings.

descriptions.tiny: Never ride with a stranger.
descriptions.small: Two friends become caught up in an airport shuttle driver's (Tony Curran) deadly game.
descriptions.medium: Two friends (Cameron Goodman, Peyton List) become caught up in an airport shuttle driver's (Tony Curran) deadly game.
descriptions.large: Best friends Mel (Peyton List) and Jules (Cameron Goodman) are returning from a holiday in Mexico when they board an airport shuttle in the States. It's there they join two young men and an older business executive in what they believe to be a short journey home. But when the driver (Tony Curran) makes an unexpected detour into a dark and uninviting section of the city, it becomes clear the shuttle is taking its unwitting passengers somewhere else entirely.

descriptions.medium: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

descriptions.tiny: Don't look up.

descriptions.medium: Strange lights over Los Angeles herald the arrival of malevolent aliens who threaten to swallow up humanity.
descriptions.large: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

descriptions.medium: Heir to a line of werewolves, a teenager (Landon Liboiron) battles a pack of beasts and his own lust for blood.

descriptions.medium: Cuando su hijo se enamora, una mujer divorciada sufre una crisis existencial que pone en riesgo su segundo matrimonio.

descriptions.tiny: An indebted grifter launches a website that exploits women.
descriptions.small: To pay his gambling debts, a grifter (C. Thomas Howell) launches a website that exploits women.

descriptions.tiny: A young woman strives to be a professional dancer in Miami.
descriptions.small: Dancers band together to save their historic neighborhood from a developer.
descriptions.medium: Newly arrived in Miami, an aspiring dancer (Kathryn McCormick) joins forces with the leader (Ryan Guzman) of a flash-mob dance crew to save the historic neighborhood from a developer.
descriptions.large: Newly arrived in Miami, young dancer Emily (Kathryn McCormick) dreams of becoming a professional. She soon meets and falls in love with Sean (Ryan Guzman), the leader of a dance crew called "the Mob." When a rich businessman's plans to develop the dancers' historic neighborhood threatens to displace thousands of people, Emily must join forces with Sean and the Mob to turn their performance art into protest art, even though doing so may place her dreams in jeopardy.

descriptions.tiny: The first real ghost story.

descriptions.medium: Hired to debunk a supposed haunting, paranormal investigators come face-to-face with an angry spirit more terrifying than they have ever imagined.

descriptions.small: Siete pistoleros viajan por el desierto y luchan por sobrevivir mientras buscan El Dorado.

descriptions.medium: Una monja llega a un pueblo y tiene problemas con el sacerdote, debido a su comportamiento poco ortodoxo, pero, finalmente, ambos comprenden que persiguen el mismo fin: ayudar a las personas.

descriptions.tiny: Every diva deserves an encore.
descriptions.small: A once-popular opera diva (Maggie Smith) reunites with her ex-husband at a retirement home.
descriptions.medium: A long-smoldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star (Maggie Smith) reunites with her ex-husband (Tom Courtenay) and fellow performers (Billy Connolly, Pauline Collins) at a retirement home for musicians.
descriptions.large: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

descriptions.tiny: A racehorse helps a teenage girl overcome a tragic loss.
descriptions.small: A teenager overcomes a tragic loss by working with a racehorse trainer and his talented runner.
descriptions.medium: A teenager (Julianne Michelle) overcomes a tragic loss by working with a talented racehorse and establishing a relationship with the mother (Claire Forlani) she never knew.

descriptions.tiny: A mutual ex-lover brings together a group of strangers.
descriptions.small: A mutual ex-lover brings together a group of strangers at a bar in downtown Los Angeles.
descriptions.medium: A mutual ex-lover (Katee Sackhoff) brings together a group of strangers at a bar in downtown Los Angeles.

descriptions.tiny: This is not a game.
descriptions.small: An unusually gifted youth is selected for advanced training to defend Earth against alien invaders.
descriptions.medium: After an alien invasion, an unlikely recruit commands Earth's forces and fights for the future of humanity.
descriptions.large: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

descriptions.tiny: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles an orchestra of space scientists.
descriptions.small: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles the world's first orchestra made up of space scientists.
LA Xtreme gives you an inside look at their team and processes.

descriptions.tiny: A man embarks on a global search for a set of mystic relics.
descriptions.small: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) searches for a set of 12 Chinese zodiac bronze heads.
descriptions.medium: A treasure hunter (Jackie Chan) and his team set out on a global quest to find a set of Chinese zodiac bronze heads that were stolen from a Beijing palace in the 19th century.

descriptions.tiny: A model's murder brings together a photographer and a cop.
descriptions.small: A model's murder brings together a fetish photographer and a homicide detective.
descriptions.medium: A fetish photographer and a homicide detective develop an unlikely friendship as they probe the murder of a model.

descriptions.tiny: Catana Starks coaches a college men's golf team.
descriptions.small: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team.
descriptions.medium: Catana Starks becomes the first woman to coach a collegiate men's golf team and subsequently guides her misfit players to an all-time-record championship season.

descriptions.tiny: The National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity.

descriptions.medium: Filmmaker James Costa investigates the National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity, and shows what schools, parents, authors, doctors, politicians, celebrities, and chefs are doing to combat the problem.

descriptions.tiny: Five strangers band together to survive a night of mayhem.
descriptions.small: Five strangers must band together to survive a night of government-sanctioned carnage.
descriptions.medium: Three groups of people intertwine and are left stranded in the streets on Purge Night, trying to survive the chaos and violence that occurs.
descriptions.large: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

MV005664310000.title: Love in the Time of Monsters

descriptions.tiny: Two sisters battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes.
descriptions.small: Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes.
descriptions.medium: Two sisters staying in a tourist trap battle toxic monsters wearing Bigfoot costumes to save the ones they love.

descriptions.tiny: Competitive puzzlers prepare for a large contest.
descriptions.small: Top teams in competitive puzzling prepare for the largest contest in the country.

descriptions.tiny: Welcome to a new world of gods and monsters.

descriptions.medium: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia, and terrors that defy human comprehension.
descriptions.large: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

descriptions.tiny: You either know one, you have one, or you are one.

descriptions.medium: A high-school senior (Mae Whitman) sets out to reinvent herself and revolutionize the student body's social order after learning that a judgmental classmate has given her an embarrassing nickname.
descriptions.large: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

descriptions.tiny: A Brooklyn gang member takes a teen under his wing.

descriptions.medium: A longtime gang member (James 'Primo' Grant) shows a fast-taking teen (John Diaz) how to operate on the mean streets of Brooklyn, N.Y.

descriptions.tiny: Three entrepreneurs struggle to start a brewery.

descriptions.medium: Three entrepreneurs struggle to start a brewery, while one restaurateur fights to keep his empire afloat.

descriptions.medium: Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

descriptions.tiny: A young gymnast battles a group of bank robbers.
descriptions.small: A young gymnast (Kaya Scodelario) battles a group of bank robbers at the home of her boyfriend.

descriptions.tiny: A family battles a supernatural force that preys on fear.

descriptions.medium: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.
descriptions.large: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

descriptions.tiny: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a school teacher.
descriptions.small: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher to recover stolen data.
descriptions.medium: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

descriptions.tiny: Strength defines us. Based on the inspiring true story.
descriptions.small: Jeff Bauman embarks on a heroic journey after losing his legs in the Boston Marathon bombings.
descriptions.medium: Jeff Bauman loses both of his legs when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013. With unwavering support from his family and girlfriend, Bauman embarks on a long and heroic journey to physical and emotional rehabilitation.
descriptions.large: Jeff Bauman loses both of his legs when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013. After regaining consciousness in the hospital, Jeff is able to help law enforcement identify one of the suspects, but his own battle is just beginning. With unwavering support from his family and girlfriend, Bauman embarks on a long and heroic journey to physical and emotional rehabilitation.

descriptions.tiny: The early history of Fat Wreck Chords.

descriptions.medium: Two loving parents raise their daughter in separate households. When the father falls in love with another woman and plans a Christmas wedding, his ex sets in motion a diabolical plan to ruin their fairy-tale wedding.

descriptions.tiny: It's just business.

descriptions.medium: An assassin is sent to kill a young woman but finds himself unable to pull the trigger. They form an uneasy alliance and flee from their pursuers.

descriptions.tiny: We are his pawns, his demons on Earth.
descriptions.small: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move to a new home.
descriptions.medium: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move into their dream home.

descriptions.tiny: Mercenaries protect a woman from elite assassins.

descriptions.medium: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

descriptions.tiny: Contracted to kill. Fighting to survive.

descriptions.medium: After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.

descriptions.tiny: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers.

descriptions.small: Robin Hood and Little John lead a band of oppressed rebels against the evil Sheriff of Nottingham.
descriptions.medium: A war-hardened Crusader and his Moorish commander mount an audacious revolt against the corrupt English crown.
descriptions.large: After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

descriptions.tiny: Punks run afoul of the law and an unhinged park ranger.

descriptions.medium: A group of Punk-styled friends, fueled by a hallucinogenic drug called Echo, runs afoul of the law and an unhinged park ranger.

descriptions.tiny: Who would you become to save your family?

descriptions.medium: A woman finds herself in big trouble when a cartel leader forces her to do his dirty work to save her kidnapped friend. Determined to get away, she must now play a dangerous game to outwit the gang -- and the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.
descriptions.large: Young Gloria seeks help from the police when cartel hit men kidnap her friend from a nightclub in Mexico. She soon finds herself in big trouble when a corrupt cop hands her over to the same goons who shot up the place. Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

descriptions.tiny: The life and works of Mirzo Ulugh Beg.
